CROSS-CUTTING THEME for deep analysis -- creatinine-based eGFR as a fragile ADPKD trial endpoint. The negative lanreotide kidney RCT (pm_42320793), the marginal CAM2029 liver-volume result (NCT05281328), and the somatostatin network meta-analysis (pm_42476150, imp 4 / ev 3, sparse network + FAERS with no denominator) together suggest measurable cyst-volume effects without demonstrated patient-important benefit.
